name: Plan Well
tagline: A personalized 7-day Indian meal planning web application.
overview: Plan Well is a responsive web application that generates personalized 7-day Indian meal plans based on the user's weight, state, diet preference, and preferred number of meals per day. The application also allows users to securely sign in with Google, save generated meal plans, revisit previous plans, delete saved plans, and submit feedback through an intuitive interface.
